answerPassages.question: Who can answer Navarre permit and land-use questions?
answerPassages.answer: Santa Rosa County Development Services handles planning, permitting, building inspections and floodplain questions. Its official services page provides the starting route. Confirm jurisdiction and the proposed use for the exact parcel; a general guide cannot approve a renovation or rental.
answerPassages.scope: County service scope, not parcel-specific approval
answerPassages.caveat: Confirm jurisdiction and the proposed use for the exact parcel; a general guide cannot approve a renovation or rental.

answerPassages.question: Does a mainland address eliminate flood concerns?
answerPassages.answer: Flood risk extends beyond mapped high-risk zones. The National Flood Insurance Program explains why the map is only part of the coverage decision. Check the actual parcel, drainage and policy requirements before treating a mainland address as a low-cost insurance finding.
answerPassages.scope: General NFIP risk, not local probability
answerPassages.caveat: Check the actual parcel, drainage and policy requirements before treating a mainland address as a low-cost insurance finding.
